description: Implementation of the FrameTracer class for Android's SurfaceFlinger, handling tracing of graphics frame events, fences, and layers using Perfetto.

classes.name: FrameTracer
classes.description: Class responsible for tracing graphics frame events, fences, and layer information in Android SurfaceFlinger.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the FrameTracer, setting up Perfetto tracing.

methods.name: registerDataSource
methods.description: Registers the FrameTracer data source with Perfetto.

methods.name: traceNewLayer
methods.description: Records the creation of a new layer with its ID and name.

methods.name: traceTimestamp
methods.description: Logs a timestamp event for a specific layer and buffer.

methods.name: traceFence
methods.description: Records fence signal events and pending fences for buffers.

methods.name: tracePendingFencesLocked
methods.description: Processes and logs pending fences for a buffer.

methods.name: traceLocked
methods.description: Creates a trace packet for a buffer event with details.

methods.name: traceSpanLocked
methods.description: Creates a span trace between start and end times.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes tracing data for a specific layer.

methods.name: miniDump
methods.description: Returns a summary string of current tracing state.
